judgment.rationale: The exact Shift+digit-during-drag behavior is covered by the existing approved fork design for #50149 and open upstream draft PR #50695. The PR is still pending review and merge, so this is existing in-progress coverage rather than a resolved defect.
evidence: The issue gives ordered steps: create and number a FancyZones layout, drag with the right mouse button, hold Shift, then press the assigned number; switching fails in v0.101.2362.
A commenter confirms the same Shift+number symptom.
Current FancyZonesLib/FancyZones.cpp::FancyZones::OnKeyDown requires Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit for the drag branch.
Open draft PR #50695 changes that exact condition; fork issue #633 contains the existing implementation design. No matching fork issue or PR for #51054 was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Reuse the existing #50149/#633 design and draft PR #50695; do not start a separate fix/design for the same code path.

fix_assessment.rationale: The same narrow drag-time quick-layout behavior is the subject of an approved fork design and an open upstream draft PR.
